plan.goal: Size the per-chromosome .bed files and count the per-chromosome files for a GWAS genotype dataset of 13171 samples and 8637765 variants (1470600 on the largest chromosome).
plan.rationale: PLINK binary .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant, so per-chromosome .bed size = n_samples × n_variants_chr / 4 / 1e6 MB. The number of per-chromosome files is the number of chromosomes represented; estimated as ceil(total_variants / largest_chromosome_variants) = ceil(8637765/1470600) = 6, assuming the largest chromosome is representative. The user must confirm the actual chromosome count in the data (human GWAS typically spans 22 autosomes + X + Y = 24 chromosomes).
caveats: The 6 per-chromosome files is a ceiling estimate from total/largest-chromosome variant counts; confirm the actual number of chromosomes represented in the dataset (human GWAS typically 24: 22 autosomes + X + Y).
Per-chromosome .bed size (4842 MB) is for the largest chromosome only; other chromosomes are smaller and their .bed files will be proportionally smaller.
Disk budget should account for the total dataset .bed (~28.4 GB) plus .bim/.fam companion files.
